text: dsh-skill-pack 是面向 DSH 的工程技能包，通过插件挂载目录中的 SKILL.md，并注册技能 wiki 工具。它提供会话交接、教学、规格与工单整理、代码审查、设计文档等工作流技能，还能把经验记录整理成模式、提议技能并审核启用状态。主要通过 DSH 技能目录和 skillwiki 工具使用。适合希望在 DSH 中复用工程流程或积累团队知识的开发者。需要 DSH 及其技能文件系统提供方；代码使用本地 DSH_HOME 目录存放 wiki 数据。

dsh-skill-pack adds engineering skills to DSH, including handoffs, teaching, code review, and specifications. Its tools record experience, consolidate patterns, and propose or approve skills. It needs the DSH skill filesystem provider and stores wiki data locally under DSH_HOME.
我想让 DSH 的新 agent 快速接手当前会话。
帮我把讨论整理成规格说明和实施工单。
我想在工作区里循序渐进地学习一个新概念。
Help me turn lessons from a coding session into reusable skills.
I need an agent to audit a skill library for broken references and duplicated content.
Can I import recent ACP summaries as material for future workflows?
dsh-skill-pack 的功能「工程工作流技能」：在 DSH 中挂载随包提供的技能目录，包含会话交接、教学、代码审查、规格与工单等工作流。用户通过 DSH 的技能能力调用相应技能，按其指引生成交接文档、学习材料或工程规划。
dsh-skill-pack 的功能「技能 wiki 演进」：用工具记录开发经验、归纳模式、提议技能并审核启用；状态和审计工具可查看 wiki 与技能包情况。
dsh-skill-pack 的功能「ACP 摘要导入」：skillwiki_ingest 可读取最近的 ACP checkpoint 摘要，并保存为 wiki 经验记录。

@snow-the/dsh-skill-pack README · dsh-skill-pack：Curated engineering skills for DeepSeek Harness — **cross-platform by
construction** (pure SKILL.md text mounted via the host's filesystem
provider; zero platform-specific code, zero runtime dependencies beyond
the DSH-hosted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`).

@snow-the/dsh-skill-pack README · Skills (29)：| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `handoff` | Compact the conversation into a handoff doc for another agent |
| `teach` | Teach the user a new skill or concept in-workspace |
| `to-spec` / `to-tickets` / `to-questionnaire` | Turn conversations into spec/tickets/questionnaires |
| `implement` | Implement a piece of work from a spec or tickets |
| `triage` | Move issues/PRs through triage roles |
| `wayfinder` | Plan huge work as a map of decision tickets |
| `loop-me` | Grill specs for workflows to build |
| `ask-matt` | Router over the skills in this pack |
| `zoom-out` | Get broader context / higher-level perspective |
| `improve-codebase-architecture` | Scan for deepening opportunities, HTML report |
| `setup-ts-deep-modules` | Wire dependency-cruiser for deep-module TS repos |
| `wizard` | Generate an interactive bash wizard for manual procedures |
| `api-and-interface-design` | Stable API/interface design (Hyrum's Law, contract-first) |
| `code-review-and-quality` | Multi-axis code quality review gate |
| `code-simplification` | Simplify code for clarity without behavior change |
| `deprecation-and-migration` | Retire old systems
